description: Settings for tools/demo/android-demo.sh. Relative paths are relative to the repository root. Times are seconds at --pace 1.

apk.description: First file that exists wins. Pass --apk to override. The CI release job produces Polishot.apk; a local build produces app-debug.apk.

avd.description: Used only with --boot-avd. The emulator image needs no Google Play: text recognition is bundled and nothing touches the network.
avd.name: polishot_demo

recording.description: adb shell screenrecord limits: 180 s at most per file. bitRate is bits per second.

sample.description: The made-up billing screen (same image as the web and Windows demos). Render it with: node tools/demo/web-flow-demo.mjs --sample-only

saved.description: Where the editor's Save writes (MediaStore relative_path).

ui.description: Text the script looks for in the screen's accessibility tree (a regular expression, case-insensitive). The editor is a WebView; if its nodes are not exposed on your image, the script taps the fractional position in 'fallback' instead (x, y as a fraction of the screen, approximate for a 20:9 phone).
